"''You cannot disguise yourself from me…Jedi.|Kento Marek and Darth Vader|}} A '''battle''' took place around [[18 BBY/Legends|18 BBY]], barely a [[Standard year/Legends|year]] after the end of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]], the [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of the [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] [[Species/Legends|race]]. It was fought by the [[Imperial Army/Legends|ground forces]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] under the command of the [[Supreme Commander (Galactic Empire)/Legends|Supreme Commander]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]] against the Wookiees and the fugitive [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Kento Marek]], who had managed to survive the initial phase of the [[Great Jedi Purge/Legends|Great Jedi Purge]] that began at the onset of [[Order 66/Legends|Order 66]]. In addition to the [[Battle of Kashyyyk (19 BBY)|previous Imperial invasion]] of Kashyyyk, the battle marked the successful conclusion of the Empire's campaign to subjugate and [[Slavery/Legends|enslave]] the Wookiee race. While the main force was on a stand by, platoon of stormtroopers led by Captain [[Janzor]] was sent to distract the Wookiees from the main invasion force. Their main objective was to capture a small outpost with a relay so that the Wookiees won't be able to signal the rest of the natives, in which the platoon succeeded. Some time later the platoon was overwhelmed by the Wookiees who had them outnumbered most of the platoon was killed at the outpost including Captain Janzor, Sergeants Oswal Strepp and Dalia, only two stormtroopers made it alive. A few hours after Janzors platoon had landed on the planet, most of the continents were already under Imperial control. At first, the Wookiees were able keep the invaders at bay, mainly by ambushing Imperial [[Soldier/Legends|soldiers]] immediately after they descended on Kashyyyk's surface. Though displeased by the initial setback, [[Lord/Legends|Lord]] Vader ignored most of the battle in order to pursue a personal objective—the hunt for the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] Kento Marek. With only a handful of [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]], including the members of [[Triton Squad]], the [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]] infiltrated the Wookiee village where much of the fighting took place, and [[Death/Legends|killed]] numerous Wookiees along the way to his target. Upon confronting Marek at the Jedi's [[Kento Marek's hut|home]], the two fought a brief [[Lightsaber duel/Legends|lightsaber duel]] in which Vader quickly gained the advantage and disarmed his opponent. Shortly afterward, he discovered the Jedi's son [[Galen Marek]], a child who was exceptionally [[Force-sensitive/Legends|strong]] in [[The Force/Legends|the Force]]. The realization that the younger Marek could prove useful to the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] caused Vader to spare the [[Gender/Legends|boy's]] life, although he swiftly killed Marek's [[Parent/Legends|father]], as well as a few nearby [[Trooper/Legends|troopers]] in order to ensure that his discovery remained a secret. In the years that followed Kashyyyk's fall to the Empire, [[Darth/Legends|Darth]] Vader secretly raised and [[Sith training|trained]] Galen Marek in the ways of the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side of the Force]] while still [[Sith apprentice/Legends|apprenticed]] to [[Palpatine/Legends|Darth Sidious]], the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] who ruled the [[The galaxy/Legends|galaxy]] as [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] Palpatine, despite the fact that there could only be [[Rule of Two/Legends|two]] Sith. Vader broke this rule in the hopes that his secret apprentice, whom he codenamed "Starkiller," would eventually become powerful enough to help him assassinate Sidious. ==Prelude== Prior to the [[19 BBY/Legends|conclusion]] of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knights]] [[Kento Marek|Kento]] and [[Mallie Marek]] abandoned their duty as members of the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] and [[Jedi General/Legends|officers]] in the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] after they fell in love with each other. Shortly after marrying in secret, the couple learned that Mallie was pregnant, causing her to give birth to their son, [[Galen Marek]]. Not long afterward, the Jedi Order and the Republic crumbled under the rise of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], thus forcing all Jedi fugitives, including the [[House of Marek|Marek family]], into hiding.{{DB|character|starkiller|Starkiller (Darth Vader's Secret Apprentice)}} As [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] consolidated [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] under his [[New Order/Legends|New Order]], Kento and his family eventually settled on [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]] where they were welcomed and provided with shelter by the native [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] population. Mallie was [[Death/Legends|killed]], however, when she sacrificed her life while defending the Wookiees from [[Trandoshan/Legends|Trandoshan]] [[Slavery/Legends|slavers]]. With his wife dead, Kento was left alone to raise their young son. Not long after Mallie's death, [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]] discovered Kento's presence on Kashyyyk and responded by launching a full scale invasion of the Wookiee homeworld. ==The battle== ===Initial invasion=== {{Quote|Lord Vader, we were ambushed upon arrival, but I have the situation well in—''"
"''I have no interest in your failures, Commander. I am here on a mission of my own.|Darth Vader chokes the Imperial Commander|}} [[File:SecondBattleOfKashyyyk.jpg|thumb|left|220px|[[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]] fights [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiees]] while searching for the Jedi fugitive.]] The initial attack was a disaster for the Galactic Empire, causing many Imperials to lose their lives for underestimating the defenses of Kashyyyk's Wookiee population. The initial wave of Imperial troopers soon learned that the Wookiees were surprisingly well prepared for the invasion; such an oversight caused them to be overwhelmed and massacred by the Wookiee counterattack. When Darth Vader arrived on Kashyyyk, he was unconcerned with the progress of the battle due to his single-minded focus on hunting down the Jedi fugitive who eluded [[Order 66/Legends|Order 66]]. As stormtroopers died around him, the Sith Lord was approached by a nervous [[Unidentified Imperial commander (Kashyyyk)|Imperial commander]] who tried to excuse his incompetence by assuring Vader that all was under control. Gripping the commander in a Force choke, Vader made it clear that his full attention was required for his own personal mission, and thus he spared the commander's life, if only because he could not be bothered to personally command the troops against the Wookiees. ===The hunt for Kento Marek=== [[File:Kento_vs_Vader.jpg|thumb|right|250px|Kento Marek makes his last stand against Darth Vader.]] While the main Imperial force engaged the Wookiees in a brutal frontal assault, Vader infiltrated the enemy base with a small escort of stormtroopers from [[Triton Squad]]. Marching through the Wookiee village where the resistance was centered from, the Sith Lord struck down every [[Berserker|Wookiee warrior]] that stood in his path, thus crushing the resistance and clearing a path for the Imperials along the way. The Wookiees attempted to swarm Vader at a network of bridges that led to the Jedi's hut; at least one [[TIE/ln space superiority starfighter/Legends|TIE fighter]] was shot down and crashed into a bridge as Vader drew closer to his objective. Although the fierce Wookiees rushed at the Sith Lord in an attempt to halt his advance, Vader killed every last one of them until finally reaching his destination. Kento Marek, initially disguised as a reclusive hermit, emerged from the hut with two Wookiee guards at his side. He tried to dissuade Vader from continuing any further, but the Sith Lord saw right through the Jedi's ruse and proceeded to attack his enemy. With no other option left, Marek was forced to confront Darth Vader in a fight to the death. Although Marek succeeded in neutralizing Vader's stormtrooper escort with a powerful [[Telekinesis/Legends|telekinetic blast]], he soon discovered that Vader was not so easily harmed by the Jedi's Force abilities. Recognizing Vader's [[Lightsaber combat/Legends|superior skills]] with the [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]], Marek used the Force to catch several TIE fighters in the sky and hurled them at Vader. Despite his valiant efforts, Marek was ultimately no match against Vader's greater skills and strength in the Force. The [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord]] easily disarmed the Jedi of his weapon, seized him with the Force and sent him crashing through the front entrance of Marek's own hut. ===Discovery of Galen Marek=== {{Quote|A son…|Darth Vader|}} [[File:Starkiller_toylightsaber.jpg|thumb|left|240px|Darth Vader meets the boy whom he chooses as his apprentice.]] Upon entering the hut, Vader used the Force to levitate and trap Marek in mid air. Yet his hand was stayed for a moment before delivering the killing blow due to the extremely powerful presence that Vader suddenly felt in the Force. Assuming that it was the Jedi's [[Kento Marek's Jedi Master|Master]], Vader demanded to know where the mysterious [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-user]] was hiding. When Marek refused to cooperate, a frustrated Vader raised his saber to strike the Jedi down in anger. Before he even realized it, his own weapon was snatched out of his hand, causing him to turn around in surprise. To Vader's utter shock and astonishment, he found his lightsaber in the small hands of a very [[Galen Marek|young boy]]. After quickly deducing that the child was the son of the Jedi in his grasp, Marek warned his son to run away, a selfless act that got him killed when Vader immediately strangled him to death. As Vader observed the frightened child in front of him, the Dark Lord was instantly impressed by the boy's unique potential in the Force—a potential that rivaled powers of Emperor Palpatine himself. But just as he started to cautiously approach the boy so as to not alarm him, the Imperial commander and three stormtroopers arrived on the scene. Believing that the child was threatening the Sith Lord with Vader's own weapon, the commander directed the troops to execute the boy. But after a mere moment of indecision, Vader telekinetically took his lightsaber back and defended the boy from the troopers' blaster shots. As the boy looked on in horror and confusion, Vader slaughtered the commander and the stormtroopers without hesitation. After killing all of the witnesses who knew of the boy's existence, Vader took his new charge away from the hut before Imperial reinforcements could arrive on the scene. ==Aftermath== {{Quote|You were weak when I found you. Now, your hatred has become your strength. At last, the dark side is your ally. Rise, my apprentice.|Darth Vader|}} [[File:Vader_Starkiller.png|thumb|right|250px|Darth Vader acknowledges Starkiller as his Sith apprentice.]] The Second Battle of Kashyyyk ended with a decisive Imperial victory, which then immediately led to the full subjugation of Kashyyyk and the enslavement of the Wookiee population. Unknown to the Imperials who participated in battle, Darth Vader took Kento Marek's son into his care and raised him on the incomplete [[Executor/Legends|''Executor'']]. For years, the boy who was once known as Galen Marek was forced to endure years of [[Sith training|brutal training]] under the close observation of his [[Sith Master/Legends|new master]]. Barely into young adulthood, the boy had forgotten all about his former life, including his birth name. Under the codename ''Starkiller'', the boy learned to become a relentless and merciless [[Sith assassin/Legends|assassin]] who dedicated his life to eliminating Vader's enemies. Due to the extreme raw strength that Starkiller possessed in the Force, Vader spent many years pushing his young disciple's potential to the pinnacle of his powers. The result of such a training regimen turned Starkiller into one of the most powerful Force-users in history, despite his young age. As the [[Sith apprentice/Legends|secret apprentice]] to Darth Vader, Starkiller longed for the day when he and his master could finally overthrow Emperor Palpatine, thus allowing them to rule the Empire as master and apprentice in an official capacity. ==Behind the scenes== The Battle of Kashyyyk is featured as the introductory level of the video game ''[[Star Wars: The Force Unleashed|The Force Unleashed]]'', where the player controls Darth Vader. Vader's advanced [[Force power/Legends|Force powers]] become readily available to the player from the start, showing what would the player character, [[Galen Marek]], would strive to achieve later in the game. The [[Wookiee warrior]]s and [[Berserker|Wookiee berserker]]s that appear in the introductory level were designed by the art team of the game based on the Wookiee characters that appear in the earlier [[Battle of Kashyyyk]] in {{Film|III}}, thus forming a familiar continuity with the movies. [[Amy Beth Christenson]] added several armor, gears, melee weapons and other details on the Wookiee characters.''[[The Art and Making of Star Wars: The Force Unleashed]]'' [[File:Kashyyyk_Trooper_TFU.png|thumb|left|300px|The stormtrooper armor seen in the PS3, PC, and Xbox 360 editions]] The two versions of game depict different versions of the battle. In both versions, the Imperial forces wear armor that is a hybrid between stormtrooper and Phase II Clone Trooper armor. In the PS2, Wii and PSP versions, the troopers feature Clone Wars-era 501st Legion markings, but in the PS3, PC and Xbox 360 versions, their armor has no markings and the helmet design is slightly different, with a noticeable ridge under the visor and a small gap between the black band and the top of the visor. Additionally, the battle develops during the night in the PS2, Wii and PSP versions with Vader arriving with the Invasion force while in the other versions the battle develops during the day and Vader arrives midway into the assault. The setting of Kento and Vader's duel also differs, as the PS2, Wii and PSP versions have it take place on a beach, while the others have it take place outside the Marek home in the forest. In the [[Wikipedia:PlayStation 2|PlayStation 2]] and [[Wikipedia:Wii|Wii]] versions, the commander in charge of the operation that Darth Vader Force-choked was relegated to a Stormtrooper Commander while as the [[Wikipedia:PlayStation 3|PlayStation 3]] and [[Wikipedia:Xbox 360|Xbox 360]] versions had him resembling an Imperial Officer. On a related note, while the Xbox 360/PS3 versions make it clear that Darth Vader spared him, the way the PS2/Wii/PSP versions handled the Commander's fate was ambiguous, as the scene immediately cut to behind Vader after releasing his grip. In the Xbox 360 and Playstation 3 versions of the game, if the player kills twelve stormtroopers under Vader's command they receive an achievement/trophy called "Worst Day Shift Manager Ever," which is part of the subtitle of an award winning fan film series called [https://starwarsfans.fandom.com/wiki/Chad_Vader:_Day_Shift_Manager ''Chad Vader'']. Coincidentally, [[Matthew Sloan]], the voice of Chad Vader,[[w:c:starwarsfans:Chad_Vader:_Day_Shift_Manager|''Chad Vader: Day Shift Manager'']] also portrayed Darth Vader in ''The Force Unleashed''.
